description:
Activate Boommobile's crew ability by tapping Deadeye Navigator, causing Boommobile to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters, its soulbond ability triggers, pairing it and Boommobile.
Activate Boommobile by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Boommobile enters, it triggers, adding {U}{U}{U}{U} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
